Hi Sam / Elena,

Appreciate the clarity on scope you provided this morning. Attached are the materials we discussed:
- redwood-export-assurance-matrix.csv (default processing & fallback routing per data category)
- rwd-dpa-annex-draft-v1.pdf (Redwood draft DPA annex with SCC/DPF supplement and optional clauses redlined)
- transfer-mapping-summary.xlsx (per-category residency mapping and recommended contract language)

Executive summary (short):
- Transfer mechanism: We adopt the EU Commission SCCs as the contractual baseline. For EU→US transfers we include our DPF supplement that documents supplementary technical and organisational measures. For customers with elevated requirements we offer Redwood Private (VPC/on-prem) or Dedicated deployments to provide regional-only processing.
- Technical supplements: default encryption at rest and in transit with AES-256; optional customer-managed keys (KMS integration) for Dedicated/Private plans. We recommend customer KMS when data residency/separation is a gating requirement.
- Subprocessors: primary cloud infra, GPU hosting partners, and managed logging. See attached subprocessor snapshot (tab in CSV). We notify customers 30 days prior to adding new subprocessors and provide a remedy window; emergency additions are disclosed retrospectively per contract.
- Retention & logs: request/response logs retained by default 90 days; KV cache metadata 30 days; audit trail (security events) retained 1 year. Retention adjustments are configurable via contract or repo-level settings; we can accommodate shorter windows for sensitive datasets with cost/engineering alignment.
- Auditing & evidence: we can provide SOC2 reports, export-control attestations, and per-request audit logs on a scoped basis.

Next steps:
1) Please review the attached DPA annex redline and call out any non-starters. We can accept a single PDF with redlines or comments.
2) If you want guardrails tightened (e.g., customer KMS enforced, or Private deployment requirement), indicate that and we will scope pricing/ops.
3) I'll open a HubSpot ticket and attach final artifacts for procurement review: https://hubspot.com/contacts/HD-24518

If helpful, I'm available Thu 09:00–12:00 PT for a quick legal + security walkthrough.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
